entities.summary: David Owen (Dewi Wyn o Eifion) (1784 Llanystumdwy, Caernarfonshire – 17 January 1841) was a Welsh poet and farmer. He is noted especially for his work in two traditional Welsh verse forms: the awdl and the englyn.
